tools.title: Tools
tools.nbt-editor.privacy: Files never leave your browser — parsing and export both run locally in WebAssembly
tools.nbt-editor.wasm-failed: The WebAssembly core failed to load
tools.nbt-editor.wasm-failed-hint: This usually means the .wasm asset was not served. Rebuild the tool's wasm package, then reload the page.
tools.nbt-editor.open-failed: That file could not be opened
tools.nbt-editor.crash: The NBT tool hit an unexpected error
tools.nbt-editor.crash-hint: Dismissing this keeps the rest of the page running. If it keeps coming back, reload the page — your file was never uploaded anywhere.
tools.nbt-editor.foot.hints: Enter or blur commits an edit · Escape cancels it · edits stay local until you press Export
tools.nbt-editor.state.modified-title: The tree has been edited, so the file will be re-serialized on export.
tools.nbt-editor.state.original-title: The tree is untouched, so exporting writes the original bytes back verbatim.
tools.nbt-editor.expand2-title: Expand the first two levels of the tree
tools.nbt-editor.compression-title: Wrapper used when the edited tree is re-serialized. An unmodified document is always exported as the original bytes.
tools.nbt-editor.close-title: Close this file and clear the editor
tools.nbt-editor.export-dirty: Serialize the edited tree and download it
tools.nbt-editor.comp-changed: Exporting as {0} instead of {1}. This only applies once the tree has been modified — an untouched file is exported byte-for-byte as it was opened.
tools.nbt-editor.add-root-title: add an entry to the root compound
tools.nbt-editor.drop.title: Drop an NBT file here
tools.nbt-editor.drop.hint: gzip, zlib and raw NBT are detected automatically. Existing worlds, structure files and schematics all open.
tools.nbt-editor.drop.reject: '{0}' does not look like an NBT file. Expected .dat, .nbt, .mcstructure or .schematic — or rename a raw gzip/zlib payload to end in .dat.
tools.nbt-editor.root.single: The root of this file is a single {0} tag, so there are no children to show.
tools.nbt-editor.row.add-item: add a {0} item to this list
tools.nbt-editor.editor.name: name of this {0} tag
